Student Researcher Guide

\n \n

    Set up and sign in

    2. \n
  2. 2
    Review your profile

    Confirm your institutional and contact information after signing in.

    3. \n
  3. 3
    Enter research information

    Create a draft and provide the required project and adviser details.

    4. \n
  4. 4
    Complete requirements

    Upload every mandatory document and resolve pending or rejected items.

    5. \n
  5. 5
    Submit and monitor

    Submit only when the checklist is complete, then follow status updates and deadlines.

    6. \n
  6. 6
    Respond and access results

    Submit requested revisions and access released decisions or certificates.

    7. \n
